statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is a stock's price on day i.
The span of day i is the number of consecutive days ending on day i, counting day i itself and going backwards, on which the price was less than or equal to prices[i].
Return the span of every day.

examples.explanation: On day 5 the price 75 is at least the prices of days 2 to 5, giving span 4. On day 6, 85 covers every day back to day 1, giving span 6.
The price rises every day, so each span reaches back to day 0.
